root_cause: Casting gate design allowed gas entrapment near the bore face, producing subsurface porosity that was only revealed once machining removed the skin.
immediate_containment: Batch quarantined at goods-in and returned to supplier. Remaining stock 100% inspected after rough machining.
corrective_action: Supplier revised the gating and venting arrangement for the bore region and re-qualified the pattern.
preventive_action: Porosity inspection added to the supplier's final inspection routine for all castings from this pattern family.
verification_method: Inspection of the next three delivered batches after rough machining.
verification_result: Effective - no porosity findings in the three batches following implementation.

root_cause: Cutting tool used for the hub face had exceeded its intended life, degrading the achieved surface finish.
immediate_containment: Affected impellers segregated and returned for refinishing.
corrective_action: Tool change interval for the hub face operation reduced and recorded on the setup sheet.
preventive_action: Tool life monitoring added to the operator check sheet for the milling cell.
verification_method: Surface roughness measurement on 10 parts from the following two deliveries.
verification_result: Effective at the time of verification - all measured parts within the drawing requirement.

root_cause: Manual deburring of the port edges was inconsistent between operators and no defined edge condition was specified on the drawing note.
immediate_containment: Batch sorted and deburred at goods-in before release to stores.
corrective_action: Deburring operation defined with a specified edge break and a reference sample provided to the operators.
preventive_action: Edge condition added to the inspection check sheet for all ported bodies.
verification_method: Visual inspection against the reference sample on the next two batches.
verification_result: Partially effective - improvement seen but the condition recurred, see NCR-2026-010.

root_cause: Fixture locating pin wear allowed part rotation during the port drilling operation.
immediate_containment: Two affected bodies rejected. Remaining batch 100% CMM checked.
corrective_action: Locating pins replaced and a wear check added to the fixture maintenance schedule.
preventive_action: Fixture wear checks extended to the other two drilling fixtures used for this family.
verification_method: CMM check of port position on the following two batches.
verification_result: Effective - all checked positions within tolerance.

root_cause: Grinding wheel dressing interval was too long for the wheel grade in use, allowing the wheel to load and produce chatter.
immediate_containment: Affected parts returned for regrinding.
corrective_action: Wheel dressing interval shortened and specified on the operation sheet.
preventive_action: Dressing interval reviewed for the other grinding operations on the same machine.
verification_method: Surface finish measurement on the next two deliveries.
verification_result: Partially effective - finish improved but a related grinding burn condition later occurred, see NCR-2026-019.

root_cause: The reduced tool change interval from CA-002 was recorded on the setup sheet but not built into the machine's tool life counter, so it depended on the operator remembering it.
immediate_containment: Affected impellers segregated and returned for refinishing.
corrective_action: Tool life limit programmed into the machine controller so the tool change is prompted automatically.
preventive_action: Controller-based tool life limits applied to the other finish operations in the cell.
verification_method: Surface roughness on 10 parts per delivery for three consecutive deliveries.
verification_result: Effective at the time of verification - no findings across the three deliveries checked.

root_cause: Grinding wheel offset was corrected in the wrong direction after a wheel change, producing an undersized bore.
immediate_containment: Part rejected. Remaining batch 100% inspected before release.
corrective_action: Offset correction after a wheel change made a two-person verified step on the setup sheet.
preventive_action: First-off approval requirement introduced after every wheel change on critical bore operations.
verification_method: Bore diameter check on the first-off part after the next three wheel changes.
verification_result: Effective - all first-off parts within tolerance.

root_cause: Melt handling practice allowed slag carryover into the pour for one heat, producing inclusions.
immediate_containment: Batch held at the supplier and re-inspected after rough machining.
corrective_action: Pouring procedure updated with a defined skimming step and a hold time before pouring.
preventive_action: Melt handling procedure reviewed with the foundry and applied to all heats for this alloy.
verification_method: Ultrasonic and visual inspection after rough machining on the next four batches.
verification_result: Partially effective - no inclusions found in the four batches checked, but porosity recurred later on the same component, see NCR-2026-025.

root_cause: The reference sample provided under CA-003 was not controlled, and the sample in use at the supplier had been damaged, so the accepted edge condition had drifted.
immediate_containment: Batch sorted and deburred at goods-in.
corrective_action: Reference samples brought under document control with a defined replacement interval and identification.
preventive_action: Controlled reference samples introduced for all visual and edge-condition acceptance criteria at this supplier.
verification_method: Visual inspection against the controlled sample on four consecutive batches.
verification_result: Effective - no burr findings across the four batches following implementation.

root_cause: Finish turning feed rate at the second-source supplier was set from a generic process sheet rather than the part-specific parameters.
immediate_containment: Two affected shafts rejected and replaced.
corrective_action: Part-specific finish turning parameters issued to the supplier and recorded in their process sheet.
preventive_action: Process parameter records reviewed for the other parts supplied by this second source.
verification_method: Surface finish measurement on all shafts in the next two deliveries.
verification_result: Partially effective - condition improved but recurred later, see NCR-2026-027.

root_cause: Boring bar deflection under a worn insert produced an oversized bore on the last part of the run.
immediate_containment: Part rejected. Remaining housings 100% CMM checked.
corrective_action: Insert change point defined by part count for the boring operation and added to the control plan.
preventive_action: Insert life defined by part count for the other bored features on this component.
verification_method: CMM bore measurement on all housings in the next three deliveries.
verification_result: Effective - all measured bores within tolerance.

root_cause: Initial assessment attributed the upward trend to normal tool wear within the existing offset correction practice. This was later shown to be incomplete, see CA-018.
immediate_containment: Journal diameter recorded and trended on every incoming shaft rather than on a sample.
corrective_action: Supplier asked to tighten the tool offset correction frequency for the finish turning operation.
preventive_action: Trend review of the journal diameter added to the weekly incoming quality review.
verification_method: Review of journal diameter trend over the following three weeks.
verification_result: Not effective - the mean continued to rise and parts subsequently fell outside specification, leading to NCR-2026-018. The investigation was reopened at a deeper level.

root_cause: Carrier outer diameter was at the top of its tolerance while the mating housing bore was at the bottom of its own, producing an interference at the tolerance stack extreme.
immediate_containment: Three affected assemblies held and the carriers replaced from an alternative batch.
corrective_action: Tolerance stack for the interface reviewed and the carrier outer diameter target moved to mid-tolerance.
preventive_action: Interface tolerance stacks reviewed for the other two press-fit joints in the centre housing.
verification_method: Measured fit check on ten assemblies at build.
verification_result: Effective - all ten assemblies within the intended interference range.

root_cause: A finish turning insert grade change was introduced in February without re-validating tool life. The control plan still specified first-off and last-off inspection only, based on the previous insert's wear behaviour, so progressive wear moved the journal diameter toward the upper specification limit between offset corrections and no in-process check existed to detect it.
immediate_containment: Two suspect batches quarantined at goods-in and returned to the supplier. 100% inspection of journal diameter introduced on all incoming shafts and at supplier final inspection. Stock on hand re-measured and segregated.
corrective_action: Supplier reverted to the validated insert grade and re-established the tool life limit for the finish turning operation. Control plan updated to require an in-process journal diameter check every fifth part and a tool offset correction at a defined cumulative part count.
preventive_action: Change control procedure extended so that any tooling or consumable change affecting a critical characteristic requires tool life re-validation and a control plan review before release. The same review was applied to the other critical rotating characteristics from this supplier, and SPC monitoring with a documented reaction plan was introduced at the supplier for the journal diameter.
verification_method: Individuals and moving range chart plus a capability study on eleven weeks of post-change inspection data, compared against the pre-change period, together with a review of repeat NCR activity for the same supplier, component and defect category.
verification_result: Effective - see the verification analysis in the application for the measured before and after values.

root_cause: Coolant concentration had fallen below the specified range, reducing heat removal during grinding and producing localised burn.
immediate_containment: Two affected parts rejected. Remaining stock etch-inspected for burn.
corrective_action: Coolant concentration check added to the daily machine start-up routine with a recorded reading.
preventive_action: Daily coolant checks introduced across all grinding machines at the supplier.
verification_method: Etch inspection of a sample from each of the next three deliveries.
verification_result: Effective - no burn indications in the three deliveries checked.

root_cause: Same root cause as NCR-2026-018. This NCR covers the additional material produced before the corrective action took effect and is closed against the same corrective action.
immediate_containment: Affected batches quarantined and returned. 100% inspection maintained until the corrective action was verified.
corrective_action: Covered by CA-018. No separate corrective action raised, as raising a second action against the same cause would fragment the verification evidence.
preventive_action: Covered by CA-018.
verification_method: Verified together with CA-018 using the post-change control chart and capability study.
verification_result: Effective - no further dimensional non-conformances on this component and supplier after the change.

root_cause: Hub thickness was machined to the low side of tolerance following a fixture shim change that was not re-qualified with a first-off measurement.
immediate_containment: Affected impeller rejected. Remaining batch 100% inspected.
corrective_action: First-off measurement required and recorded after any fixture shim or packing change.
preventive_action: First-off requirement after fixture changes applied to all critical thickness features in the cell.
verification_method: First-off records audited for the next four production runs.
verification_result: Effective - first-off measurements recorded and within tolerance on all four runs.

root_cause: Porosity has now occurred three times on this component from the same pattern. The earlier gating change under CA-001 addressed the bore region only, and the current findings are at a different location, so the pattern is being re-assessed as a whole.
immediate_containment: Batch quarantined. 100% inspection after rough machining maintained on all deliveries of this component.
corrective_action: Full pattern and gating review with the supplier's foundry, including a solidification assessment. Work in progress at the reporting date.
preventive_action: Pending completion of the pattern review. A supplier process audit has been scheduled.
verification_method: Inspection after rough machining on five consecutive batches once the revised pattern is released.
verification_result: Not yet verified - corrective action not complete at the reporting date and now past its due date.

root_cause: Parts were transported in a returnable container without individual separation, allowing flank-to-flank contact in transit.
immediate_containment: Affected parts cleaned, re-inspected and accepted.
corrective_action: Packaging specification updated to require individual part separators in the returnable container.
preventive_action: Packaging specifications reviewed for the other ground components from this supplier.
verification_method: Visual inspection at goods-in on three consecutive deliveries in the revised packaging.
verification_result: Effective - no handling damage found in the three deliveries checked.

root_cause: The part-specific turning parameters issued under CA-011 were applied to one machine at the supplier but the part was subsequently run on a second machine that still held the generic parameters.
immediate_containment: Affected shafts rejected. 100% surface finish inspection applied at goods-in.
corrective_action: Part-specific parameters loaded and verified on all machines capable of running the part. Work in progress at the reporting date.
preventive_action: Pending completion. Intended action is a check that process parameters are controlled per part rather than per machine at this supplier.
verification_method: Surface finish measurement on all shafts from the next three deliveries, recording which machine produced them.
verification_result: Not yet verified - corrective action not complete at the reporting date and now past its due date.

root_cause: Mounting face flatness is not currently a controlled characteristic on the drawing, so it was never measured at inspection despite affecting gasket seating.
immediate_containment: Affected bodies held at build. Flatness measured on all bodies in stock.
corrective_action: Flatness added as a controlled characteristic with a defined tolerance, and added to the control plan and inspection routine. Drawing change in progress at the reporting date.
preventive_action: Review of other gasket-sealed faces across the lubrication system to confirm flatness is specified where it affects function.
verification_method: Flatness measurement on all bodies from the first three deliveries after the drawing change is released.
verification_result: Not yet verified - corrective action in progress and not yet due.
